actors.name: Sunmark housing cooperative (membership as a whole)
actors.private_context: Each member has their own schedule, priorities, and views on the pet policy amendment. No member knows how many others will attend.

shared_context: Sunmark housing cooperative's bylaws require a two-thirds turnout of all members to amend the pet policy. A special general meeting has been called for September 12, 2026, to vote on the amendment. The meeting will be held at a specific time and location known to all members. Members may attend in person or by proxy as permitted by the bylaws.

starting_events.description: The special general meeting is scheduled for September 12, 2026. Members have been notified of the meeting and the proposed pet policy amendment.
visible_to: Sunmark housing cooperative (membership as a whole)

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that at least two-thirds of all members of Sunmark housing cooperative actually attended (in person or by proxy) the special general meeting on September 12, 2026, before the meeting's conclusion. Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff.
